description: Shared Renovate preset for the tftio fleet. Hosted here, in the existing shared-CI-contract repository, because policy is configuration rather than a credential -- the 'holds no secret values' rule governs secrets, not this file. A consuming repository extends it with a one-line stub; grouping, scheduling, vulnerability handling and the automerge decision all live here so each is declared once.

packageRules.description: Cargo manifest/lockfile minor and patch bumps, grouped into one weekly PR per repo. Commits as build(deps) to match the fleet's conventional-commit convention.
Cargo major bumps are reviewed individually, not grouped.

tftio/gh-actions reusable-workflow pin bumps (rust-ci.yml, rust-artifacts.yml, release-plz.yml, python-ci.yml). These are immutable vX.Y.Z tags on purpose -- rangeStrategy pin keeps the exact tag, never a range or moving alias -- and each bump is grouped into one PR per consuming repo so the tag stays consistent across that repo's workflow files. Commits as ci, matching the fleet's convention for workflow-only changes.

All other GitHub Action step references (actions/checkout, jdx/mise-action, Swatinem/rust-cache, actions/create-github-app-token, actions/cache, release-plz/action) are already pinned by resolved SHA with a trailing version comment. Renovate updates the SHA and keeps the comment's version number in sync; grouped into one PR per repo, committed as ci.
uv-managed Python projects (pyproject.toml, PEP 621 deps) minor/patch bumps grouped per repo.
mise.toml tool pins (rust toolchain, cargo:-installed CLIs, prek, cocogitto, taplo, etc.), minor/patch grouped per repo.
mise.toml major tool bumps (e.g. a Rust edition-relevant toolchain jump) reviewed individually.
